name: dag-field-presence
claim: Field presence on a DAG node is determined by structural type; aggregations and inferences require deps, prescriptions require deps or a stipulation artifact, and contract fields are prescription-only

rules.then: id, type, kind, domain, tags, claim, subjects, status, created are all valid fields
artifact (required) and evidence (dated, append-only) are valid; deps, materialized, rules, invariants are not meaningful
The node must have a non-empty deps array - an aggregation by definition composes multiple deps
The node must have a non-empty deps array - a conclusion traces its grounding even when its claim exceeds it

rules.scenario: Prescription grounds in deps or stipulation
rules.then: The node must have non-empty deps or a stipulation artifact (plan:/user:/session:/document:) - adoption is grounded in beliefs or in the record of the adoption event

invariants: Active prescriptions carry deps or a stipulation artifact
Fields are emitted in a stable schema-defined order
Fields absent in the source JSON are not emitted on round-trip (presence tracked via _keys)
tags defaults to empty list when absent from source

evidence.detail: Accepted via human adjudication against cb:b027. Reasoning: cb-schema-v2: deps requirements re-attach per type (compounds, inferences, non-contract directives under the D4 grounding rule); contract fields are directive-only. The stale 'confidence' shared-field reference is dropped in passing.

Retro-pair per the b507 close protocol: the session slug this node stipulates from is readable in the thread record - the schema-landing main body and postscripts 2-6 cover the stasis, observability, and ceremony exchanges where these stipulations were made.

Standalone-contract carve-out collapsed in step with b059 (option a of the contract-predicate-demotion seed): the 'declared contract may omit deps' rule is dropped and the grounding requirement now covers every active prescription regardless of contract grade.
